gate.consultation: Clinical features are not enabled yet. Nothing here is saved or shown until they are approved and switched on.

synthetic: Synthetic clinical data for testing only. Never enter real patient information.

workspace.title: Consultation
workspace.notStarted: The consultation has not started. Verify the patient's code and start the consultation from the visit page.
workspace.readOnly: This visit is no longer in consultation, so the draft is read-only.

context.label: Patient and visit
context.allergyNone: No allergies recorded. That does not mean the patient has none; ask.
context.allergyUnknown: Allergies not known. Ask the patient before prescribing.

status.offline: Offline. Changes are kept on this screen only

draft.leaveWarning: You have unsaved changes. They are not stored anywhere else.

vitals.intro: Record what you measured. Leave a field empty or mark it not measured. Values are saved exactly as entered.
vitals.incompleteTitle: Finish or clear this reading before leaving the step
vitals.bpBoth: Enter both systolic and diastolic values.

assessment.provisionalHint: Use when the diagnosis is not yet certain. You do not need a definitive diagnosis to finish.

prescription.name: Medicine name
prescription.discardBody: {count, plural, one {# medicine will be removed} other {# medicines will be removed}} from this draft.
prescription.allergyReview: I have reviewed the patient's known allergies
prescription.allergyReset: You changed the medicines, so confirm the allergy review again.

review.intro: Check everything before signing. After signing, the record cannot be edited; corrections are added as dated amendments.
review.ack: I confirm this record is accurate and understand it cannot be edited after signing
review.ackRequired: Confirm the statement above to sign.
review.saveFirst: Save the draft before signing. Signing uses the version saved on the server.
review.uncertain: We could not confirm the signature. Nothing was changed on screen. Try again; the same request is reused, so it cannot sign twice.
review.conflict: The record changed on the server. Review the latest version before signing.

missing.prescriptionItems: Add a medicine or choose no medicine
missing.prescriptionItemName: Enter a name for every medicine

conflict.title: This draft changed somewhere else
conflict.body: A newer version was saved, for example from another tab or device. Autosave has stopped so nothing is overwritten.
conflict.loadError: We could not load the saved version.
conflict.keepMineHint: Your on-screen text is saved over the newer version.
conflict.useServerHint: Your unsaved changes on this screen are discarded.
conflict.editedSince: You edited the draft after this comparison. Review the differences again.

record.notFound: Not found. No signed record exists for this link, and drafts are never shown as records.

amend.title: Amend signed record
amend.intro: An amendment creates a new version. The signed version stays unchanged and visible.
amend.reasonTextHint: At least 10 characters. This is shown in the record history.
amend.ack: I confirm this amendment is accurate
amend.done: Amendment saved as a new version.

collection.title: Payment collected at the visit
collection.intro: Record cash or direct UPI you received. This does not change the online payment status and does not affect the clinical record.
collection.amountInvalid: Enter an amount in rupees, for example 800 or 800.50.
collection.referenceHint: Required for UPI. Letters, digits, spaces, / and - only.
collection.notAvailable: Collection can be recorded once the consultation has started.

facts.title: Health facts
facts.intro: Patient-entered facts stay marked that way until you review evidence and confirm them. Opening the consultation verifies nothing.
facts.empty: No health facts recorded for this patient.
facts.evidenceHint: For example: blood group card, discharge summary.
facts.ack: I reviewed the evidence for the selected facts
facts.evidenceRequired: Describe the evidence you reviewed (at least 3 characters).
facts.ackRequired: Confirm that you reviewed the evidence.
facts.corrected: Correction saved. The earlier value stays in the history.

photo.title: Photo (optional)
photo.intro: A photo is never required. Take one only with the patient's specific consent and a clinical purpose.
photo.purposeHint: Shown to the patient with the consent record.
photo.patientConfirmed: The patient agreed to this specific photo
photo.declinedNote: The patient declined. This does not affect completing the consultation.
photo.withdrawnNote: Consent withdrawn. Earlier photos are no longer shown.
photo.uploadPending: Uploading photos is not connected yet, so no camera or file picker is shown.

proof.title: Proof of visit
proof.intro: A proof shows only that this visit took place. It contains no health details, address or code.
proof.notYet: A proof can be created after the patient's code is verified.
proof.qrPending: QR display is not connected yet. Share the proof code only if asked; anyone can check it on the public check page.

pdf.title: PDF of the signed record
pdf.intro: The PDF is made from the signed version only. Links are private and expire after a few minutes.
pdf.expired: This link has expired. Get a new link.
pdf.mismatch: This link is for an older version. Get a new link.
